sections.heading: What Muninn Logs is
sections.body: Muninn Logs is a personal project for logging board game plays among friends and seeing stats. It has no ads and doesn't sell or share your data with anyone for commercial purposes.

sections.heading: What we store
sections.body: Your email, so you can sign in. Your name and username, which you choose (if you sign in with Google, we take your name and email from there). The games you log or play in: date, players, leaders and points. Your friendships and friend requests. The guests without an account you add to your games (only their name).

sections.heading: Who sees what
sections.body: A game is visible to whoever logged it and whoever played in it. Your name is visible to your friends, to people who played with you, and to people you sent or received a friend request from. Your stats are visible only to you and your friends, and always as totals: your friends don't see games they weren't in. Nobody can see a list of users: to add you, someone has to know your exact username.

sections.heading: Services we use
sections.body: Supabase stores the data and handles sign-in. Vercel hosts the app. Gmail sends the sign-in codes. Google is involved only if you choose to sign in with Google. Each processes data only to provide that service.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: We only use necessary cookies: one to keep you signed in and one to remember your language. We don't use tracking or analytics cookies.

sections.heading: Deleting your data
sections.body: You can delete your account at any time from Edit profile → Delete account. Your account, profile and friendships are deleted. Games you logged where only guests played are deleted; games other people with an account played pass to one of them, so they don't lose their history. In the games that remain, your place becomes “Jugador eliminado” (deleted player), without your name. You can also ask by writing to muninnlogs@gmail.com.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For any question about your data: muninnlogs@gmail.com.

sections.heading: Use
sections.body: Muninn Logs is free and a personal project. You can use it to log your games and compare yourself with your friends. It's provided as is, with no guarantee of availability or that data will be kept forever.

sections.heading: Your account
sections.body: You're responsible for what you log from your account. Only log real games, and don't add people to games they didn't play. We may suspend accounts used to harass others or abuse the service.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: These terms and the app may change. If a change is significant, we'll say so in the app.

sections.heading: Trademarks
sections.body: Lost Ruins of Arnak and its expansions are trademarks of Czech Games Edition. Muninn Logs is not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by Czech Games Edition or its distributors.

AdminImport.title: Import games
AdminImport.description: Add many games at once from a CSV, for example from old score pads.
AdminImport.formatRows: One row per player in each game. Rows of the same game share its number in “game”; their order doesn't matter.
AdminImport.formatOptional: Optional: research, temple, idols, guardians, cards and fear (the number of fear cards; an empty cell counts as 0), date (YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY), turn (1 for whoever started, 2 for the next…; if you don't know the order, leave it empty for the whole game), leader, total (to check the sum), tiebreak (an x), board (bird, snake, waterfall, tree, monkey or lizard) and duration in minutes.
